subject: Notes on the travel complaint
text: Hi, Re the complaint about the delayed service, I think I’ve got most of it, sorry if this is scattered. They booked a train but the first leg was cancelled, then the replacement bus was late, so they missed the connection. They’re asking about the fare difference and maybe a voucher, not sure what our current policy says for weather delays. I pulled the ticket, the reference is attached, but the confirmation timestamp looks odd, maybe system lag. Could you check if comp is allowed here, and if not what wording we should use? I can draft something rough. Also, they attached photos of the timetable screen, though they are blurry. Thanks
